description: A utility class providing helper methods for interacting with the OpenTracing API, including span context injection/extraction, error logging, and span creation within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: TracingHelper
classes.description: A final utility class with static methods for span context management, error logging, and span creation in OpenTracing.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Marks a span as erroneous and logs an exception or message without finishing the span.

methods.name: getErrorLogItems
methods.description: Creates a map of log items for an error, including the error object.

methods.name: injectSpanContext
methods.description: Injects a SpanContext into a JSON object, AMQP message, or vert.x DeliveryOptions.

methods.name: extractSpanContext
methods.description: Extracts a SpanContext from a JSON object, AMQP message, or vert.x headers.

methods.name: buildChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a child-of reference to a given span context.

methods.name: buildFollowsFromSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a follows-from reference to a given span context.

methods.name: buildSpan
methods.description: Creates a span builder with a reference to a span context, with specified reference type.

methods.name: setTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Sets the sampling.priority tag and baggage item on a span.

methods.name: adoptSamplingPriorityFromContext
methods.description: Reads sampling.priority from span baggage and applies it to a span builder.
